assays.assay_description: Round black arena (1 m diameter), virtually divided into eight radiant sections, centre lit by a 75 W bulb in a dimly lit room. Rats placed in the middle 60 min after injection (and tested again at 24 h), behaviour recorded for 5 min. Measures: time of walking, line crossings, peeping, grooming events, rearings, time in central zone. Psilocybin 2 and 10 mg/kg s.c. vs ketamine 10 mg/kg i.p. vs saline.

application_type.evidence: Psilocybin was given subcutaneously (sc) while ketamine was given intraperitoneally (ip) in the volume of 2 mL/kg.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were placed in the middle of the arena 60 min after the drug injection. Their behavior was recorded for 5 min.

food_restriction.evidence: Open field arena with no food described; home cage: 'free access to tap water and typical laboratory food'

water_restriction.evidence: Open field arena with no water described; home cage: 'free access to tap water'

time_to_assay.evidence: Rats were placed in the middle of the arena 60 min after the drug injection... at 1 h (A) and 24 h (C) after administration

sample_size.evidence: Values are the mean ± SEM (n = 10). [4 groups: control, psilocybin 2, psilocybin 10, ketamine; F3,36]

outcomes.summary: At 1 h, psilocybin (2 and 10 mg/kg) decreased walking time, crossings, peeping and rearing but increased centre exploration; ketamine increased walking time. At 24 h, locomotion and rearing were unchanged, peeping was decreased by psilocybin 2 mg/kg and ketamine, and centre exploration was increased by both psilocybin doses and ketamine, interpreted as an anxiolytic effect persisting to 24 h.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin at doses of 2 and 10 mg/kg significantly decreased the time of walking... The center exploration was significantly increased by both doses of psilocybin but not by ketamine in comparison to the control... The time of walking and the number of crossings reflecting ambulatory distance were not changed by both doses of psilocybin and ketamine in comparison to the control 24 h after drug administration

judge_notes: Retained the OFT (all candidates) and kept qwen's EPM: the paper reports a psilocybin-treated EPM result, although the data are only in Supplementary S2, so most EPM items are low confidence / not_reported.
Microdialysis, Western blot and the FST (published in an earlier paper) were excluded as non-behavioural or not reported here.
OFT B1 set to 2 (4-6 measures). gemma4's score of 3 contradicts its own '4-6' category.
Per-assay application_type set to s.c. (the psilocybin route). Ketamine i.p. is noted in evidence.
Vehicle set to water ('dissolved in sterile water'); qwen's 'saline' refers to the control group's vehicle.
day_night_flipped set to not_reported (bare 12:12 mention) with high confidence, per rubric.
Ketamine dosing entry included as comparator compound. The ketamine/xylazine anesthesia used for probe implantation is not counted.
Repaired gemma4's malformed experimental_conditions structure during consolidation.
